body.purpose: Task titles, notes, descriptions. The primary reading text.

title.purpose: Bed names, modal headers, page headings. One per screen region.

label.purpose: Stage badges, week badges, bed pills, timestamps. Semi-bold for legibility at small size outdoors.

task.purpose: Task title text in task rows. 14px body weight for comfortable outdoor reading.

shadows.name: surface
shadows.purpose: Cards, week groups, fertiliser cards, bed detail panel. The standard raised-surface treatment.

shadows.name: nav-top
shadows.purpose: Mobile bottom nav bar — separates persistent nav from scrolling content.

shadows.name: nav-side
shadows.purpose: Desktop sidebar — lighter because the sidebar is infrastructure, not a focal element.

shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: Toast notifications. Heavier shadow communicates transient elevation above all content.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Color and background transitions on buttons, pills, checkboxes.

motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: Fade + translateY(8px) entrance for bed detail content.

motion.name: modal-open
motion.purpose: Modal sheet slide-up on mobile. Slight overshoot gives physical feel.

motion.name: overdue-pulse
motion.purpose: Overdue plant indicators in bed grid. opacity 1 → 0.45 → 1.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Switches from bottom-nav mobile layout to left-sidebar desktop layout.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width action button. Used for Analyse, Save Note, Apply All Fertiliser.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: block; width: 100%; background: #3d6b35; color: #f5f0e8; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Apply Button (Pill)
components.description: Compact pill button used in fertiliser bed rows and dashboard.
components.css: .ds-btn-pill { background: #5a8f4a; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 20px; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-pill:hover { background: #3d6b35; } .ds-btn-pill:disabled { background: #ccc; cursor: default; }

components.name: Bed Selector Pill
components.description: Navigation pills for selecting a bed on the Beds and Analysis tabs.
components.css: .ds-pill-group { display: flex; gap: 8px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 8px; scrollbar-width: none; } .ds-pill-btn { flex-shrink: 0; background: #e8e0d0; border: none; border-radius: 20px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #2a2a2a; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-pill-btn.ds-pill-active, .ds-pill-btn:hover { background: #3d6b35; color: #f5f0e8; }

components.name: Task Checkbox
components.description: 44x44px circular checkbox. The most-used interactive element — sized for outdoor use with imprecise taps.
components.css: .ds-task-check { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #5a8f4a; background: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; font-size: 18px; color: #3d6b35; flex-shrink: 0; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-task-check.checked { background: #5a8f4a; color: #fff; border-color: #5a8f4a; }

components.name: Stage Badge
components.description: Color-coded plant growth stage indicator. Color encodes meaning; text label always present.
components.css: .ds-stage-badge { display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 10px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.3px; } .ds-stage-growing { background: #5a8f4a; } .ds-stage-harvest-ready { background: #3d6b35; } .ds-stage-overdue { background: #8b1a1a; } .ds-stage-heading { background: #9b59b6; } .ds-stage-flowering { background: #e67e22; } .ds-stage-seedling { background: #7dba6a; } .ds-stage-germinating { background: #95c47a; } .ds-stage-seeded { background: #aaaaaa; }

components.name: Bed Card
components.description: Grid card for each raised bed. Tappable — navigates to bed detail.
components.html:
Bed 1 — Cauliflower / Beetroot🌱
🥦🥕Growing
components.css: .ds-bed-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: transform 0.1s; } .ds-bed-card:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-bed-card-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-bed-card-name { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #444; line-height: 1.2; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-bed-card-mid { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }

components.name: Fertiliser Card (Liquid Gold)
components.description: Gradient identity card for the Vasili's Liquid Gold product. One of two gradient surfaces in the system.

This Week

components.description: Current season week indicator. Always visible on the Dashboard header.
components.css: .ds-week-badge { display: inline-block; background: #3d6b35; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 20px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
This is a tool used standing in a garden. The person using it has dirt on their hands, the sun is out, and they need to know what to do right now. Every design decision flows from that physical reality: high contrast for legibility in direct sunlight, touch targets large enough for imprecise outdoor taps, information density that answers the question without making the user hunt. The aesthetic is a well-kept field notebook — not precious, not decorative, earned through use.

The palette is drawn directly from the garden it serves: deep soil greens, warm linen backgrounds, amber for urgency, the dull red of a plant in trouble. Nothing is synthetic. The system explicitly rejects the pastel-wellness aesthetic, the chrome-and-glass productivity app, and anything that looks like it was designed to win a design award before being used in a paddock.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast legibility as a non-negotiable, not a nice-to-have
Earthy, grounded palette sourced from the subject matter itself
Mobile-first with a useful desktop sidebar
Flat-by-default elevation; shadow used structurally, never decoratively
System UI font stack — fast, legible, native on every device

rules.name: The Amber Reservation Rule
rules.body: Amber (#d4860a) is for things that need attention. It is never used for branding, decoration, or positive confirmation. If amber appears on screen, it means the user should act.

rules.name: The No-White Rule
rules.body: Pure white (#ffffff) is never used as a background. All surfaces use Weathered Linen (#f5f0e8) or white cards on that canvas.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: No text below 10px. On a phone in sunlight, 10px semi-bold uppercase is the floor.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest at ground level. Shadow is earned by function — a card that contains interactive content earns a shadow; a section header does not.

dos: Do maintain WCAG AAA contrast for all task titles, bed names, and stage labels.
Do keep all touch targets at 44x44px minimum.
Do use Deep Bed Soil Green (#3d6b35) for primary actions and active states only.
Do reserve Harvest Amber and Root Rot Red for urgency and error states.
Do keep Weathered Linen (#f5f0e8) as the base canvas.
Do use the pill shape (20px radius) only for navigation elements and badges.
Do pair every color-based status signal with a text label or icon.
donts: Don't use the Better Homes and Gardens aesthetic — no soft pastels, no floral illustration.
Don't use the wellness or mindfulness app aesthetic — no inspirational copy, no muted mint and blush.
Don't add gradients except on the two named fertiliser product cards.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on general cards.
Don't animate layout properties — only opacity, transform, color, and background-color.
Don't make the app feel like a dashboard. No metric tiles, progress rings, or charts.
Don't use pure black (#000000) or pure white (#ffffff) for any background or text.
